title: RUZN.AI Legal Document Schema
description: Sovereign AI legal document schema for Oman/GCC jurisdiction. Designed for PostgreSQL storage and RAG/vector search integration. Covers Royal Decrees, Laws, Regulations, Ministerial Decisions, Circulars, Official Gazette entries, and Legal Commentary.

notes: Use UUID primary keys for all tables
articles array maps to ruzn_legal_articles with FK document_id
cross_references array maps to ruzn_legal_cross_references with FK document_id
keywords arrays map to ruzn_legal_keywords with lang column ('ar'|'en')
embedding_vector stored in ruzn_legal_embeddings as pgvector type vector(1536)
full_text_ar stored as TEXT with GIN trigram index for full-text Arabic search
Use tsvector + GIN index on summary_en for English FTS
document_id uses format RUZN-{type_code}-{year}-{number} as UNIQUE TEXT NOT NULL

sql_schema.ruzn_legal_documents: CREATE TABLE ruzn_legal_documents (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, document_type TEXT NOT NULL, title_ar TEXT, title_en TEXT, decree_number TEXT, year_hijri INTEGER, year_gregorian INTEGER, date_hijri TEXT, date_gregorian DATE, issuing_authority TEXT, gazette_number INTEGER, gazette_date DATE, subject_ar TEXT, subject_en TEXT, legal_domain TEXT, parent_law TEXT, parent_decree TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', full_text_ar TEXT, summary_en TEXT, embedding_ready BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, parsed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, parsed_by TEXT, source_file TEXT, source_url TEXT, confidence_score NUMERIC(5,2), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
sql_schema.ruzn_legal_articles: CREATE TABLE ruzn_legal_articles (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ruzn_legal_documents(document_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, article_number TEXT NOT NULL, article_text_ar TEXT, article_text_en TEXT, amends_article TEXT, is_new BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, sort_order INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
sql_schema.ruzn_legal_cross_references: CREATE TABLE ruzn_legal_cross_references (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ruzn_legal_documents(document_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, reference_type TEXT, reference_decree TEXT, reference_law TEXT, reference_article TEXT, reference_description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
sql_schema.ruzn_legal_keywords: CREATE TABLE ruzn_legal_keywords (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ruzn_legal_documents(document_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, keyword TEXT NOT NULL, lang TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lang IN ('ar','en')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
sql_schema.ruzn_legal_embeddings: CREATE TABLE ruzn_legal_embeddings (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ruzn_legal_documents(document_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chunk_text TEXT, embedding vector(1536), model_used TEXT DEFAULT 'text-embedding-3-small', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

document_id.description: Unique RUZN document ID. Format: RUZN-{type_code}-{year}-{number}. Type codes: RD=Royal Decree, LW=Law, RG=Regulation, MD=Ministerial Decision, CR=Circular, GZ=Gazette, LC=Legal Commentary, RL=Reference Link.

title_ar.description: Official Arabic title of the document.

decree_number.description: Official decree or law number (e.g., '2020/120', '1999/97'). Format: {year}/{number} for Omani decrees -- year first, always 4 digits. Stricter than reference_decree by design: decree_number states what this document IS and must be canonical, while reference_decree records what a source SAID and stays permissive so an unresolvable citation can be stored as written.

year_hijri.description: Hijri year of issuance (سنة الإصدار هجرية).

date_hijri.description: Full Hijri date string (e.g., '24 صفر 1442 هـ').

date_gregorian.description: Full Gregorian date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

issuing_authority.description: Authority that issued the document (جهة الإصدار).

gazette_number.description: Official Gazette issue number (رقم الجريدة الرسمية).

subject_ar.description: Subject or topic in Arabic (الموضوع بالعربية).

parent_law.description: The law being amended by this decree (if amendment). References the law by its common name.

parent_decree.description: The parent decree number that issued the law being amended (e.g., '1999/97' for Criminal Procedures Law). Format: {year}/{number}, same as decree_number.

status.description: Current legal status of the document.

articles.description: Array of articles/provisions in this document. Maps to ruzn_legal_articles table.

article_text_ar.description: Full Arabic text of the article.

article_text_en.description: English translation or summary of the article.

amends_article.description: Which article of the parent law this provision amends (e.g., '221-para2', '4مكررا', '164', '31').

is_new.description: True if this is a newly added article/paragraph, false if it replaces existing text.

cross_references.description: Related decrees, laws, and articles referenced by this document. Maps to ruzn_legal_cross_references table.

reference_decree.description: Referenced decree number (e.g., '1999/97'). Format: {year}/{number} where it can be resolved. Deliberately permissive (^[0-9]{2,4}/[0-9]{1,4}$): a citation to an instrument the corpus does not hold is recorded exactly as the source wrote it rather than reordered on a guess.

keywords_ar.description: Arabic keywords for search and classification. Maps to ruzn_legal_keywords (lang='ar').

keywords_en.description: English keywords for search and classification. Maps to ruzn_legal_keywords (lang='en').

full_text_ar.description: Complete Arabic text of the document. Stored as TEXT with GIN trigram index for full-text search.

summary_en.description: English summary of the document's content and significance.

extraction_metadata.description: Metadata about how and when this document was parsed into the schema.

parsed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when document was parsed.

parsed_by.description: LLM or method used for parsing.

schema_version.description: RUZN schema version used for this parse.

source_url.description: Source URL if document was fetched from web.

parse_notes.description: Any notes about the parsing process, quality issues, or missing data.

embedding_ready.description: Indicates whether this document has been processed for vector embedding and is ready for RAG search. When true, embeddings exist in ruzn_legal_embeddings table.

embedding_chunks.description: Text chunks prepared for embedding. Each chunk maps to a row in ruzn_legal_embeddings table. Chunk size: ~500 tokens. Overlap: 50 tokens.

chunk_text.description: Text content of this chunk (Arabic + English mixed for bilingual search).

embedding_model.description: OpenAI or other embedding model used.

rag_configuration.notes: For Arabic legal text, prepend English summary to each chunk for better bilingual retrieval. Use pgvector extension with ivfflat index for production scale.
